effect.name: GM Gradient Map
effect.desc: A four-stop colour ramp mapped onto any channel of the layer. Pick what drives the ramp - luminance, a single channel, alpha, hue, saturation or lightness - then set the four colours and where the two middle stops sit. The ramp can be interpolated in RGB, in HSV (shortest hue path, so a red-to-blue ramp goes through magenta rather than through grey) or in luma-preserved mode, which keeps the layer's own brightness and takes only the ramp's colour. A bias curve, a contrast curve, dithering and five blend modes finish it. Layer space, so the ramp rides the layer.
